summary: Burst traffic exceeded scheduler admission capacity. Requests waited in the queue until new replicas drained the backlog.
A model artifact had an incompatible tokenizer version. Loading failed before any requests could enter the scheduler.
The scheduler queue is growing during a traffic spike. Investigation is still in progress.
Long prompts occupied every prefill slot. Pending requests accumulated behind them; admission control reduced the waiting backlog.
Invoice jobs stalled in a queue while the database was unavailable.
Autoscaling reacted too late to batch traffic. Queued requests timed out before GPU workers became available.
A short scheduler backlog added latency to a few requests.
A stale dashboard displayed an old queue-length metric; request handling was healthy.
